steps.name: dismiss
steps.eval: localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1'); const s=window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.setManualHour(13)

steps.name: select-room
steps.eval: (()=>{const s=window.__store.getState();const p=s.floorPlan;const lvls=p.levels||[];let id=null;for(const l of lvls){if(l.rooms&&l.rooms.length){id=l.rooms[0].id;break;}}if(!id&&p.rooms&&p.rooms.length)id=p.rooms[0].id;if(id)s.setPlanSelection({type:'room',id});return 'room='+id})()

steps.name: enter-room
steps.eval: (()=>{const s=window.__store.getState();const p=s.floorPlan;const lvls=p.levels||[];let id=null;for(const l of lvls){if(l.rooms&&l.rooms.length){id=l.rooms[0].id;break;}}if(!id&&p.rooms&&p.rooms.length)id=p.rooms[0].id;if(id)s.enterRoomEditor(id);return 'room='+id})()
